name: Unidentified spaceport police droid (Stobar)
description: Around 21 BBY, a Spaceport police droid responded to an emergency call from a spaceport restaurant, Plop Dribble's on planet Stobar's spaceport, after a Dathomirian Zabrak, Savage Opress, nearly choked a waitress to death. By the time the droid arrived, Savage had already fled the scene.
